tool_input.command: cd ~/source/personal/vloop && /tmp/vl-base metrics classify --help | head -20; t=$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/gate.XXXXXX"); git -C $t init -q; mkdir -p $t/test $t/src; touch $t/test/links.e2e-spec.ts $t/test/jest-e2e.json $t/src/app.ts; /tmp/vl-base -C $t init >/dev/null 2>&1; /tmp/vl-base -C $t config set metrics.stacks typescript; /tmp/vl-base -C $t metrics classify test/links.e2e-spec.ts test/jest-e2e.json src/app.ts; /tmp/vl-base -C $t --json metrics classify test/links.e2e-spec.ts test/jest-e2e.json src/app.ts; rm -rf $t
